array.string: # launchd's default PATH lacks Homebrew, which mpm searches PATH for export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" # terminal-notifier is only granted notification permission when launched through LaunchServices notify() { open -g -n /opt/homebrew/opt/terminal-notifier/terminal-notifier.app --args "$@" -group "local.mpm-plan"; } mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/mpm" # Checks every 30 days: launchd has no interval that survives shutdown, so the agent fires at login # and daily, and skips if the last successful check (plan.json is rewritten only on success) is newer [ -n "$(find "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json" -mtime -30 2>/dev/null)" ] && exit 0 # mpm runs brew with auto-update off, so sync metadata first or it reports stale versions; # --stop-on-error because sync otherwise exits 0 when a manager fails /opt/homebrew/bin/mpm --no-color --stop-on-error sync > "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.log" 2>&1 && /opt/homebrew/bin/mpm --no-color --table-format json outdated > "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json.tmp" 2>> "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.log" status=$? if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then mv "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json.tmp" "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json" rm -f "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.error" total=$(/opt/homebrew/bin/jq '[.[].packages | length] | add // 0' "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json") if [ "$total" -gt 0 ]; then notify -title "Update(s) available" -message "mpm found $total update(s). Open a new shell for details." fi else rm -f "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.json.tmp" printf 'update check failed (exit %s) at %s -- see ~/.cache/mpm/plan.log\n' "$status" "$(date)" > "$HOME/.cache/mpm/plan.error" notify -title "Couldn't check for updates" -message "mpm hit an error. Open a new shell for details." fi
